keysize.description: Set the size of minion keys to generate.

script.description: Set the default os being deployed. This sets which deployment script to apply.

log_file.description: The location of the master log file.

log_level.description: The level of messages to send to the console. One of 'garbage', 'trace', 'debug', 'info', 'warning', 'error', 'critical'.

log_level_logfile.description: The level of messages to send to the log file. One of 'garbage', 'trace', 'debug', info', 'warning', 'error', 'critical'.

log_datefmt.description: The date and time format used in log messages.

log_granular_levels.description: Logger levels can be used to tweak specific loggers logging levels. Expects a JSON object string representation.

delete_sshkeys.description: Whether or not to remove the accompanying SSH key from the known_hosts file when an instance is destroyed.

enable_cloud_grains.description: Whether or not to include grains information in the /etc/salt/minion file which is generated when the minion is provisioned.
